note:
100 sources, every one individually tested by running a domain-scoped web search and confirming it returned readable article text. Nothing is listed because it is merely indexed.

Excluded on purpose and permanently: YouTube and X (a search cannot read a video transcript or a social timeline), Reddit (post text is not reliably retrievable), and every publisher the search API rejects by name. That rejection list is why this file matters — a blocked domain fails the WHOLE search it appears in, so one bad entry in a group of six loses the other five too.

Confirmed blocked and therefore absent: football.london, Manchester Evening News, Liverpool Echo, Birmingham Live, Chronicle Live, Nottingham Post, Hull Live, Coventry Telegraph, The Argus, Sunderland Echo, Bournemouth Echo, Yorkshire Evening Post, MyLondon, EADT, Evening Standard, Daily Mail, The Sun, talkSPORT, BBC, The Guardian, The Independent, Metro, Reuters, Transfermarkt.
method: Domain-scoped web search per domain; a source is listed only where results were actually returned.
research_order: Official club news and press conferences
